// Expected values for the forester's work and the saplings' growth (docs/rules/forestry.md), captured from the original program in the
// emulator (ADR 0008): tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb goods with a finished forester's building (type 9) at a flag, reduced to
// the passes that matter. A scenario starts with a "#" line that names its verb command; each line after it gives, for a pass, the 16
// bytes of the forester (slot 4, s4=: the settler without a job the castle sends out) where his state or the way-back mark changed
// (and at a checkpoint every 500 passes), the 18 bytes of the building (b=) where they changed, the object bytes that changed
// (o=x,y:old>new;...), and the generator's words (rng=) as they stand. A sapling is the object 0x67 or 0x68; a node whose object byte
// has bit 7 (a water triangle) keeps it. The scenario saplings-grow sets saplings by hand before pass 2 (the verb's SET field), and
// goal-taken sets one on the node he walks to at pass 600, while he is on the way. Not production code: no routine of the
// program is transcribed here, only values the original gives.
